# Operator Health Check

Timestamp: 2026-03-12 08:51 UTC

## Summary
Health check completed. Host resources are stable, but there are service-level issues requiring follow-up.

## PM2
- Online: agent-log, gpu-router, iam-chat-proxy, kira-admin, kira-app, kira-dashboard, oopuo-website, openclaw-bridge, openclaw-gateway, stella-tax, whatsapp-bridge, zenithcred-website
- Alert: whisper is stopped (0 uptime, 37 restarts)

## Docker
- Healthy/up: most containers are running normally
- Alert: lidaros-frontend-1 is unhealthy
- Alert: omiximo-email-automation is unhealthy
- Alert: langfuse_langfuse-web_1 is restarting repeatedly

## Disk
- Root filesystem /dev/sda1 at 69% used (452G / 662G)
- No disk pressure alert threshold breached

## Memory
- RAM: 11.3 GB used / 27.5 GB total
- Available: 16.3 GB
- Swap: disabled
- No memory pressure alert threshold breached

## GPU
- NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090
- Temp: 40C
- Utilization: 0%
- Memory usage: 20550 MiB / 24564 MiB
- Main consumer: VLLM::EngineCore using ~20.5 GiB VRAM
- Note: high VRAM allocation but not currently at saturation

## OpenClaw Gateway
- PM2 process openclaw-gateway shows online
- openclaw gateway status reports systemd service inactive/dead (last exit 203)
- RPC probe: OK
- Listener detected on 127.0.0.1:18789
- Doctor warnings: group allowlists empty for multiple WhatsApp/Telegram configs, causing group messages to be silently dropped where policy is allowlist
- Service config flagged as out of date/non-standard; embedded token warning present
- Recommendation from tool output: reconcile to a single supported gateway service and refresh service config

## Commands Run
- pm2 list
- docker ps
- df -h
- free -m
- nvidia-smi
- openclaw gateway status

## Assessment
Overall host is stable. Primary risks are degraded application services and inconsistent gateway service supervision.
